comparison.objective: Tune and lock damping versus loosen a nut with an adjustable wrench.
comparison.physical_skill: Both demand jaw/key fit and damage-limited torque; candidate adds collar adjustment, relocking, and iterative impact-response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe impact cycles with retained setting versus specified nut loosening without rounding and wrench set-down.
comparison.reason: The record isolates adjustable-wrench use, while the candidate tests commissioning of a dynamic component. Candidate rebound/overload/drift thresholds are undeclared.
